column1: # ONE PIECE CHARACTER GENERATOR — CLONES DATABASE
# A clone is an origin, not a race. settings.csv (clone_chance) decides if a character is a clone
# if so, its race is rolled from this file instead of races.csv. Natural characters are not affected.
# race_a = biological race (pure clone) or the first component of a hybrid clone
# race_b = second component of a hybrid clone (empty = pure race clone). The order does not matter
# subtype = artificial subtype shown after the name (Seraphim-type). Empty = plain clone ("— Clone").
#           A subtype makes the clone an Artificial Hybrid.
# weight = relative probability inside this file (empty = 1, 0 = never)
# A clone keeps its components' racial values: 100% for a pure race, 50% of each component for a hybrid.
# Clone status adds no Doriki, Bounty or powers. A hybrid pair must exist in hybrids.csv.
# Invalid rows are ignored with a console warning.
